_comment: Hand-maintained inputs for the Android App Links / Digital Asset Links generator. Update the entries below whenever a new origin or WebAPK fingerprint needs to verify ownership of in-scope URLs.

siteOrigins.notes: GitHub Pages production deployment root. The generated file must be deployed at https://adam-noble-01.github.io/.well-known/assetlinks.json (lives in the user-pages repo, not this repo).

androidApps._comment: Replace the placeholder values below with the real WebAPK package name (e.g. org.chromium.webapk.a1b2c3d4e5f60718...) and SHA256 fingerprint shown by Chrome at chrome://webapks after the PWA is installed once on Android.
androidApps.notes: WebAPK package metadata. Until the placeholders are replaced the generator emits a comment-only artefact so the deployed file does not assert false ownership.
